(3) The site uses 'Oorelope' and 'Oriire' for DB seats 'Orelope' and 'Ori Ire'. (4) The site uses 'Ogbomoso-North' for DB seat 'Ogbomoso North' (state_oyo_ogbomoso_north). 26 of 32 seats covered.

anambra.notes: 10th Anambra State House of Assembly (8th Assembly), inaugurated June 12 2023. APGA 17 seats, LP 8, YPP 3, PDP 2 at inauguration. Key post-election changes: (1) Ogbaru II winner Somtochukwu Udeze was elected PDP but defected to APGA before inauguration and became Speaker. (2) Onitsha North I: original winner Douglas Egbuna (PDP) was sacked by tribunal; Justice Azuka (LP) took seat; Azuka was kidnapped Dec 24 2024, body found Feb 6 2025; by-election Aug 16 2025 won by Ifeoma Azikiwe (APGA). (3) Awka South I winner Henry Mbachu elected LP but later defected to YPP. (4) Vanguard 2023 election-night article incorrectly listed Anaocha I as APGA; multiple independent sources confirm it was LP's Nkechi Ogbuefi. Omitted seats (2/30): Onitsha North II (confirmed LP win, name not verifiable from accessible sources) and Onitsha South I (name 'Ezenwa Fredrick Chigozie' only appeared in AI-synthesised summaries of a blocked page, no independent confirmation — omitted per accuracy rule).

POST-ELECTION CHANGES APPLIED: (1) Aba North — tribunal (Court of Appeal, Nov 2023) nullified LP winner Destiny Nwangwu; PDP's Aaron Uzodike sworn in August 2024. (2) Osisioma North & Osisioma South — YPP members Iheanacho Nwogu and Fyne Ahuama defected to LP (May 2024). (3) Isiala Ngwa South — Rowland Ceaser defected PDP→LP (Feb 2025); court dismissed PDP seat-vacancy challenge (May 2026). (4) Isuikwuato — Lucky Nweke Johnson defected PDP→LP (March 2025). (5) Isiala Ngwa North — Collins Ugochukwu Iheonunekwu defected PDP→LP (April 2025). (6) Bende North — Nnamdi Ibekwe defected PDP→LP (October 2025). (7) Umuahia West [officially Umuahia North] — Akaliro Anderson defected APC→LP (September 2025). (8) Ukwa East — Lewis Obianyi defected PDP→LP (December 2025). REMAINING PDP MEMBERS (no confirmed defection found through mid-2026): Mandela Obasi (Ohafia North), Emmanuel Ndubuisi (Bende South), Solomon Akpulonu (Obingwa East), Erondu Uchenna Erondu (Obingwa West), Chijioke Uruakpa (Ugwunagbo), Godwin Adiele (Ukwa West). Portal also omits Aba Central, Osisioma North, Osisioma South from its HTML table (likely display/JS issue) but those members are confirmed from Speaker inauguration reports and Guardian defection article. Coverage is 'partial' because (a) Umuahia West/North name mismatch creates DB mapping ambiguity and (b) some post-Dec-2025 developments may not be captured.

akwa_ibom.notes: 26-seat assembly. 2023 general election: PDP won 24 seats, YPP won 2 (Ibiono Ibom and Ikono). Ibiono Ibom had a rerun election on 3 Feb 2024 won by Moses Edet Essien (YPP) after initial result was set aside. In June 2025, 24 of 26 members defected from PDP (and YPP) to APC following Governor Umo Eno's own defection to APC; the YPP state chapter had already collapsed into APC in early 2024. The two members who remained in PDP are Sunday Johnny (Onna) and Uduak Ekpo-Ufot / Uduakobong Ekpo-Ufot (Etinan), both loyalists of former Governor Udom Emmanuel. All other 24 members are now APC. The PDP website listing (pdpakwaibom.org) reflects the pre-June-2025 composition and lists incorrect/previous-assembly names for some seats; it has been disregarded in favour of INEC/press-verified 2023 election winners. Uduak Uffot (Etinan, as named in 2023 election results) = Uduak Ekpo-Ufot (confirmed same person via Wikipedia and Facebook page). Speaker: Udeme Otong (Abak, APC); Deputy Speaker: Kufreabasi Edidem (Itu, APC).

Wanzam Mohammed (Zaki constituency, PDP) died 21 June 2026 after brief illness — seat VACANT, no by-election yet announced; constituency OMITTED. (3) Court of Appeal sacked Speaker Suleiman and Deputy Jamilu Dahiru (Nov 2023); both won Feb 2024 re-run elections (PDP) and resumed their positions in Mar 2024. APC Minority Leader Bala Abdu Rishi (Lame) remains APC. 4 Bauchi federal Reps defected to APM June 2026 but these are FEDERAL not state seats — state assembly APM defectors beyond Speaker not individually confirmed in reliable sources. CONSTITUENCY NAME NOTES: Official INEC/NSHA uses sub-names like 'Disina', 'Sakwa', 'Katagum Zaki', 'Hardawa', 'Chiroma' which are matched to our DB display names (Shira I=Disina, Shira II=Shira, Zaki=Sakwa, Katagum, Hardawa=Hardawa, Chiroma=Chiroma). Our DB 'Misau' constituency has no direct match — Misau LGA splits into Chiroma and Hardawa; we map Chiroma→Chiroma and Hardawa→Hardawa but 'Misau' itself is not a recognised separate constituency so omitted. 'Bauchi' DB seat = 'Bauchi Central' (Jamilu Dahiru). 'Toro' DB seat = 'Toro/Jamaa' (Saidu Hamza, PDP). 'Warji' = Lawal Garba (PDP) per official site. 'Alkaleri' DB name: Alkaleri LGA has TWO seats — Pali Alkaleri (our 'Pali' DB seat, APC, Garba Aminu) and Duguri/Gwana (our 'Duguri/Gwana' DB seat, PDP, Bala Abdullahi Dan). 'Lame' = Bala Abdu Rishi (APC, Minority Leader confirmed Jan 2025 Tribune).
